metadata.description: Safecall: nothing is written before a copy exists, nothing is read before you have seen the list, and no answer ends without saying what was not checked.

plugins.name: safecall
plugins.description: A copy before every change and one sentence to undo it; the list of files before they are read; an answer that says what nobody checked; and three ready readings of a document - the catch, the missing piece, fact against opinion.
